<h1 id="home-title">Hi, I&rsquo;m Philipp.</h1>
<p class="hero-lede">I&rsquo;m an economist and data scientist in Vienna. I use machine learning and other empirical methods to understand economic development, drawing on conventional economic data as well as unconventional sources such as the biographies of famous people.</p>
<p class="academic-role">Head of Data Science, <a href="https://ecoaustria.ac.at/">EcoAustria</a> · Lecturer, WU Vienna · Affiliate, <a href="https://centerforcollectivelearning.org/">Center for Collective Learning</a></p>
